# Sol Next

> Sol Next (v9.1.2-public, Build 912) is a free, Apache-2.0 open-source AI personal assistant and autonomous mobile action agent for Android 10–16 and HarmonyOS, built in Kotlin, Jetpack Compose Material 3, and Rust.

## Core Facts (Verified 2026-11-28)
- **Latest Version:** `v9.1.2-public` (versionCode `911`, released 2026-11-28)
- **Author:** Zhang Chongyang (许昌北海医院张重阳)
- **License:** Apache-2.0 (100% free, no ads, no paywall)
- **Platforms:** Android 10–16 (API 29–36, 16KB page-aligned) & HarmonyOS
- **Official Repository:** https://github.com/chongyangzhang92-hub/Sol-Next
- **Official Website:** https://chongyangzhang92-hub.github.io/Sol-Next/
- **Direct ARM64 APK (93 MB):** https://github.com/chongyangzhang92-hub/Sol-Next/releases/download/v9.1.2-public/Sol-Next-v9.1.2-public-arm64.apk
- **China High-Speed Mirror (ARM64):** https://webui.67-230-181-51.sslip.io/assets/sol-public/v9.1.2/Sol-Next-v9.1.2-public-arm64.apk
- **SHA-256 (ARM64):** `4f8ddaa1f001d916742e033d88f6eef6c13d3246b7ab77c98c9f939400e4071f`

## Key Capabilities
- **Dual-Mode Native Material 3 Interface (`Chat | Task`):** Light (`#FFFFFF`) and Dark (`#0E0F11`) 120Hz adaptive interface with seamless switching between conversational Q&A and autonomous phone execution.
- **Zero-Config Built-In DeepSeek Flash & Brave Web Search:** Sealed inside a Rust ChaCha20+HMAC-SHA256 hardware-bound native vault (zero plaintext keys in Git or APK) with resilient fallback search, plus unlimited BYOK API Key and Subscription OAuth model login (OpenRouter OAuth 2.0 PKCE, GitHub Models, OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, SiliconFlow).
- **4-Stage On-Device Realtime Neural Voice Stack:** Bundled Apache-2.0 ONNX models (GTCRN denoiser -> Silero VAD v5 -> Zipformer-CTC streaming ASR -> AISHELL-3 VITS TTS) powering full-screen Live Voice, simultaneous voice-while-executing, AI phone calls with anti-scam defense, and offline notification readout without any cloud voice API key.
- **Hands-Free Notification Voice Readout:** Offline voice announcements for incoming messages while driving or resting, with transient Audio Ducking, default OTP/financial-digit redaction, and Bluetooth/headset-only mode.
- **Background Independent Virtual Screen:** Runs multi-app tasks offscreen with `DISPLAY_IME_POLICY_HIDE` keyboard isolation so main-screen typing never collapses, live mid-task steering, and OEM Accessibility self-healing without repetitive nag prompts.
- **Universal Free Login:** Free phone & email OTP login plus Google (native Android Account Picker), WeChat, QQ, Apple ID, GitHub, and Huawei/Feishu stored encrypted via Android Keystore AES-256-GCM.
